entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: Capital of Almaaz on the Terisian Isles of Dominaria; the oldest city of Terisiare still standing.

entities.name: Old Sumifa
entities.description: The first city, buried by a sandstorm in 35 AR.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother in the Brothers' War whom the songmages joined.

entities.name: Samor the Collector
entities.description: Mishra's slave who created a secret Circle of mages.

entities.name: Porros the Raptor
entities.description: Sumifan royal heir cursed into a sand wraith.

entities.name: Circle
entities.description: Samor's secret circle of mages shielding Sumifa and Almaaz.

entities.name: Songmages
entities.description: Sumifan mages who joined Mishra's side.

entities.name: Fall of Sumifa
entities.description: Burial of the old city in 35 AR.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War in which the songmages joined Mishra.

events.summary: Songmages join Mishra's side to avoid ruination of their homeland.
events.quote: the songmages of Sumifa joined the war on the side of Mishra

events.summary: Samor creates a secret Circle to shield Almaaz; Porros tries to seize it.
events.quote: Mishra's slave Samor the Collector, created a secret Circle of mages himself.

events.summary: Porros slashes Samor's throat; dying Samor curses him into a sand wraith.
events.quote: a dying Samor cursed Porros into becoming a taloned sand wraith.

events.summary: Porros summons a desert twister burying Sumifa.
events.quote: Porros summoned a massive desert twister over the city, burying it under tons of desert sand.

events.summary: A new Sumifa is founded around 1300 AR.
events.quote: Around 1300 AR, a new city of the same name was built not far from the first city's site.

events.summary: Ruins of ancient Sumifa are excavated around 3050 AR.
events.quote: an excavation site would bring to light the ruins of ancient Sumifa

relations.quote: slashed his throat with a piece of broken mirror
Sumifa is the capital of Almaaz
joined the war on the side of Mishra
